assignments.name: Tristan da Cunha
assignments.location_role: Natural Earth ADM1 feature is a two-part source geometry corresponding spatially to Tristan and Gough; statutory role and its fit as a location tier remain unverified.
assignments.land_and_islands: Official Tristan Government page calls out four main island groups: Tristan, Nightingale (incl. Middle and Stoltenhoff), Inaccessible, Gough. Current geometry has Tristan and Gough components; current region has separate unowned Inaccessible location; no Nightingale location is in the current region inventory. Small island scale/generalization leaves exact coverage unresolved.
assignments.settlements: Tristan Government states Edinburgh of the Seven Seas is its only settlement. Gough is described as uninhabited with a South African meteorological station; official Nightingale and Inaccessible pages describe both as uninhabited. Do not classify research station as a settlement.
assignments.political_separation: Natural Earth names Saint Helena as admin/geographic unit and UK as sovereignty reference. These fields are not physical-geography evidence and are not accepted as historical attributes.
assignments.unowned_neighbor: atlas:island:geonames:3370905 (Inaccessible Island); current neighbor only, not modified or copied
assignments.recommendation: Recover absent SHN source policy profile and add a source crosswalk for the government-listed island groups, Natural Earth two source components and current separately scoped Inaccessible ID. Withhold complete parent decisions; do not mutate area membership, location shapes or shared boundary in this packet.
